description.zh: SMB用户名。长度限制为1~32个字符，可以是英文、数字或符号短划线（-）、下划线（_）。
description.en: The SMB username. The username must be 1 to 32 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (\_).

descriptions.zh:
调用该接口时，您需要注意：

- 请确认您已经创建了一个云存储网关，如果还未创建，可以通过CreateGateway接口创建一个云存储网关。
 
- 如果您的云存储网关链接AD服务器，该接口将会失败，在这种情况下，您可以在AD服务器上删除SMB用户。
descriptions.en:
When you call this operation, note the following:

- Make sure that you have created a Cloud Storage Gateway. If not, you can call the CreateGateway operation to create one.
- If your Cloud Storage Gateway is connected to an Active Directory (AD) server, this operation fails. In this case, you can delete the SMB user on the AD server.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sgw delete-gateway-smb-user --gateway-id gw-000c6hshwukkbrypj000 --username username --region cn-hangzhou
